WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1791234442152
    AND e.ts_ms < 1794431242152
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'signup_started', 'signup_completed', 'subscription_started')
),
s1 AS (
  SELECT pid, MIN(ts_ms) AS t1
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = '$pageview' AND ts_ms < 1793826442152 AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY pid
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT s1.pid, s1.t1, MIN(ev.ts_ms) AS t2
  FROM s1 JOIN ev ON ev.pid = s1.pid
  WHERE ev.event = 'signup_started'
    AND ev.ts_ms > s1.t1
    AND ev.ts_ms <= s1.t1 + 604800000
    AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY s1.pid, s1.t1
),
s3 AS (
  SELECT s2.pid, s2.t1, s2.t2, MIN(ev.ts_ms) AS t3
  FROM s2 JOIN ev ON ev.pid = s2.pid
  WHERE ev.event = 'signup_completed'
    AND ev.ts_ms > s2.t2
    AND ev.ts_ms <= s2.t1 + 604800000
    AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY s2.pid, s2.t1, s2.t2
),
s4 AS (
  SELECT s3.pid, s3.t1, s3.t2, s3.t3, MIN(ev.ts_ms) AS t4
  FROM s3 JOIN ev ON ev.pid = s3.pid
  WHERE ev.event = 'subscription_started'
    AND ev.ts_ms > s3.t3
    AND ev.ts_ms <= s3.t1 + 604800000
    AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY s3.pid, s3.t1, s3.t2, s3.t3
)
SELECT 1 AS step, '' AS bd, COUNT(*) AS n, 0 AS dt_ms FROM s1
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS step, '' AS bd, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s2.t2 - s2.t1) AS dt_ms FROM s2
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS step, '' AS bd, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s3.t3 - s3.t2) AS dt_ms FROM s3
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 AS step, '' AS bd, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s4.t4 - s4.t3) AS dt_ms FROM s4
